section_summary.extract_value: This Procedure section describes ethics approval, recruitment via the Prolific Academic website, and that the survey was hosted on Qualtrics; eligibility was limited to adult United Kingdom citizens with high Prolific approval ratings. It reports that participants completed the measures in randomized order, that the survey took about 12 minutes on average and participants were paid £1.00, but it does not provide sample size, demographic breakdowns, BMI values, measurement instruments for body appreciation, or correlation statistics.
